title: View dashboard overview and reach statistics
description: Verifies the user can see an overall balance and recent transactions on the dashboard and can navigate to statistics from there.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the dashboard overview to finish loading
Scroll to the recent transactions section
Click the navigation option to open statistics
Verify the statistics view is displayed

title: Add a valid transaction and see it in recent transactions
description: Verifies the user can submit a valid transaction and it appears in recent transactions after submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /add-transaction
Fill a valid amount into the amount field
Select a valid date in the date field
Select a valid account
Select a valid category
Submit the transaction
Click the navigation to return to the dashboard
Verify the new transaction is visible in the recent transactions list

title: Start manual transaction entry from dashboard
description: Verifies the user can navigate from the dashboard to add a new transaction.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the dashboard to finish loading
Click the primary action to add a transaction
Verify the add transaction view is displayed

title: Categorize an inbox transaction and move it to recent transactions
description: Verifies the user can categorize an incoming inbox transaction and it is removed from the inbox and appears in recent transactions.

steps.description: Navigate to /inbox
If the inbox is empty, stop this test case execution as the required UI state cannot be created from the inbox view alone
Open the details or actions for the first inbox transaction
Select a category for the transaction
Confirm categorization for the transaction
Verify the categorized transaction is no longer present in the inbox list

title: Create a new account and see it listed
description: Verifies a user can create an account with required details and see the new account appear in the accounts list.

steps.description: Navigate to /accounts
Click the action to add a new account
Fill a unique account name into the account name field
Fill a valid opening balance into the balance field
Submit the account form
Verify the new account appears in the accounts list

title: Filter statistics by date range updates breakdowns
description: Verifies the user can filter statistics by a date range and the charts and category breakdowns update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /stats
Select a valid start date in the date range filter
Select a valid end date in the date range filter
Apply the date range filter
Verify the statistics charts and category breakdowns update to reflect the selected date range

title: Edit an existing account and see list reflect changes
description: Verifies a user can edit an existing account and the updated details are reflected in the accounts list.

steps.description: Navigate to /accounts
Click the action to add a new account
Fill a unique account name into the account name field
Fill a valid opening balance into the balance field
Submit the account form
Select the created account from the accounts list to edit
Update the account name to a new unique name
Save the account changes
Verify the accounts list shows the updated account details

title: Create a budget and view progress and remaining
description: Verifies a user can create a budget with a target and period and then see budget progress and remaining amount displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to /budgets
Click the action to create a new budget
Fill a unique budget name into the budget name field
Select a valid budget period
Fill a valid target amount into the budget amount field
Submit the budget form
Verify the new budget shows progress and remaining amount

title: Drill into a category from statistics chart shows category details
description: Verifies the user can drill into a category from a statistics visualization and see detailed category statistics.

steps.description: Navigate to /stats
If a date range filter is present, apply a valid date range
Interact with a visible chart segment to drill into a category
Verify a detailed view for the selected category is displayed

title: Dismiss an inbox transaction removes it from the inbox
description: Verifies the user can dismiss an incoming inbox transaction and it is removed from the inbox list.

steps.description: Navigate to /inbox
If the inbox is empty, stop this test case execution as the required UI state cannot be created from the inbox view alone
Open the details or actions for a different inbox transaction than used for categorization
Dismiss the transaction
Verify the dismissed transaction is no longer present in the inbox list

title: Inspect budget spending in statistics from budgets view
description: Verifies the user can navigate from a budget to statistics to inspect related spending for that budget.

steps.description: Navigate to /budgets
Click the action to create a new budget
Fill a unique budget name into the budget name field
Select a valid budget period
Fill a valid target amount into the budget amount field
Submit the budget form
Click the navigation option from the budget area to inspect spending in statistics
Verify the statistics view is displayed

title: Assign a category to an existing transaction
description: Verifies a user can assign a category to an existing transaction and the transaction shows the selected category afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /categories
Click the action to create a new category
Fill "Utilities" into the category name field
Select the expense category type
Submit the category form
Click the navigation to go to add a new transaction
Fill a valid transaction amount into the amount field
Select a valid account for the transaction
Fill a valid date into the transaction date field
Submit the transaction form
Click the navigation to go back to category management
Start the flow to assign a category to an existing transaction
Select the transaction you just created
Select the category named "Utilities"
Save the transaction category change
Verify the selected transaction shows category "Utilities"

title: Create recurring transaction schedule and see it listed
description: Verifies a user can create a recurring transaction schedule with an amount and frequency and then see the new schedule appear in the recurring list.

steps.description: Navigate to /recurring
Click the action to create a new recurring schedule
Fill a name or description for the recurring schedule
Fill a valid amount into the amount field
Select a valid frequency for the schedule
Submit the recurring schedule form
Verify the new recurring schedule is displayed in the recurring list

title: Create expense category and see it listed
description: Verifies a user can create a new category by providing a name and type and then see it in the category list.

steps.description: Navigate to /categories
Click the action to create a new category
Fill "Groceries" into the category name field
Select the expense category type
Submit the category form
Verify a category named "Groceries" is displayed in the category list

title: Edit an existing recurring schedule and see updates in the list
description: Verifies a user can edit an existing recurring schedule and the list reflects the updated schedule details.

steps.description: Navigate to /recurring
Click the action to create a new recurring schedule
Fill a name or description for the recurring schedule
Fill a valid amount into the amount field
Select a valid frequency for the schedule
Submit the recurring schedule form
Click the action to edit the recurring schedule you just created
Change the amount to a different valid amount
Submit the schedule updates
Verify the recurring list shows the schedule with the updated amount

title: Add transaction requires mandatory fields
description: Verifies the add transaction form prevents submission with missing required fields and shows validation errors while staying on the form.

steps.description: Navigate to /add-transaction
Submit the transaction without filling all required fields
Verify validation errors are visible and the transaction is not submitted

title: Edit an existing category and see it updated
description: Verifies a user can edit a category and the updated category appears in the category list.

steps.description: Navigate to /categories
Click the action to create a new category
Fill "Dining Out" into the category name field
Select the expense category type
Submit the category form
Click the action to edit the category named "Dining Out"
Fill "Restaurants" into the category name field
Submit the category updates
Verify a category named "Restaurants" is displayed in the category list

title: Add transaction allows a negative amount for expense
description: Verifies the user can enter a negative amount for an expense transaction and successfully submit it so it appears in recent transactions.

steps.description: Navigate to /add-transaction
Fill a negative amount into the amount field
Select a valid date in the date field
Select a valid account
Select a valid category
Submit the transaction
Click the navigation to return to the dashboard
Verify the new transaction is visible in the recent transactions list

title: Prevent account creation when required fields are missing
description: Verifies the account creation form shows validation errors and does not create an account when required fields are missing.

steps.description: Navigate to /accounts
Click the action to add a new account
Leave required fields empty
Submit the account form
Verify required-field validation errors are displayed

title: Reject invalid budget amount
description: Verifies the budget form prevents submission with an invalid amount and shows a validation error while staying on the form.

steps.description: Navigate to /budgets
Click the action to create a new budget
Fill a unique budget name into the budget name field
Select a valid budget period
Fill an invalid value into the budget amount field
Submit the budget form
Verify an amount validation error is visible

title: Statistics date range validation prevents invalid ranges
description: Verifies the statistics date filter prevents selecting or applying an invalid date range and shows a validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /stats
Select a start date that is after the end date
Apply the date range filter
Verify a date range validation error is visible and the statistics view does not switch to a filtered result state

title: Category creation requires name and type
description: Verifies the category form prevents creating a category when required fields are missing and shows a validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /categories
Click the action to create a new category
Submit the category form without filling required fields
Verify a category form validation error is visible
Verify no new category is added to the category list

title: Statistics empty state is shown when there is no data
description: Verifies the statistics view shows an appropriate empty state when there are no transactions to chart.

steps.description: Navigate to /stats
Verify an empty state is visible indicating there is no data to display

title: Recurring schedule requires mandatory fields
description: Verifies the recurring schedule form prevents submission when required fields are missing and shows a validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /recurring
Click the action to create a new recurring schedule
Submit the recurring schedule form without filling required fields
Verify a form validation error is visible
Verify no new recurring schedule is added to the recurring list

title: Inbox empty state is shown when there are no incoming transactions
description: Verifies the inbox view shows an empty state when there are no incoming transactions to review.

steps.description: Navigate to /inbox
Verify an empty state is visible indicating there are no incoming transactions
